description: This file is a shell script for a Git hooks/update hook, which enforces repository access policies such as who can update specific branches or tags, and whether updates are fast-forward only. It includes functions for granting or denying access, and reads configuration files to control permissions based on branch patterns, user identities, and group memberships.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with code 0, indicating permission granted.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with code 1, indicating permission denied.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages if verbose mode is enabled.
